facts.label: Agora e promessas
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para o que acontece agora: I’m cooking. Use I’ll + verbo para prometer: I’ll call you back.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para falar do que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m cooking dinner. He is walking to the station. Ao telefone, esse tempo é muito usado para dizer onde você está e o que faz.

facts.label: Will
facts.sub: Para prometer ou decidir na hora, use I’ll + verbo: I’ll call you back. I’ll bring the drinks. Depois de will, use sempre o verbo base, sem to e sem -ing.

compare.us: Em inglês: I’m cooking, com am/is/are + -ing, e I’ll call you, com will.

pages.title: A flat in Melbourne · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Thursday evening in a flat in Melbourne. Tom is in the kitchen with his headphones on. The screen of his phone lights up. It is his friend Bruno. Bruno is outside in the street. Tom answers the call.
“Hi, Tom! Are you busy now?” says Bruno. “A little. I’m cooking dinner.” says Tom. “I’m calling about Saturday. Are you coming?” says Bruno.
